A sword that balances strength and beauty as elegantly as this one is a rare find.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 36 |durability = 36 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Broadsword}} Royal Broadswords are one-handed [[Sword]]s that deal 36 damage. They can be found in [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] and are occasionally wielded by [[Silver Bokoblin]]s and [[Golden Bokoblin]]s. Before the [[Great Calamity]], the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] would award these swords to [[Hylian Knight]]s who achieved remarkable feats. They balance strength and beauty elegantly, making them rare. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Royal Broadsword: * {{SSB}} Series [[Young Link]] amiibo * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{LA}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Link]] (Rider) amiibo Due to their metallic composition, Royal Broadswords will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they are capable of conducting [[Electricity]]. They also will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They sink if they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but since they are magnetic, they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune.
